name: guaraci
description: Language support for Guaraci .gc templates: Lua tag highlighting, snippets, and linting via guaraci check.

scripts.test:grammar: vscode-tmgrammar-snap -g test/grammars/html.tmLanguage.json -g test/grammars/lua.tmLanguage.json -g test/grammars/js.tmLanguage.json -g test/grammars/css.tmLanguage.json -g test/grammars/c.tmLanguage.json -s text.html.gc 'test/fixtures/*.gc'

guaraci.checkCommand.markdownDescription: Guaraci CLI binary used for linting (as installed by LuaRocks). May be an absolute path. Falls back to the `guaraci.luaPath` interpreter when not found.

guaraci.luaPath.markdownDescription: Lua interpreter used by the fallback linter when `guaraci.checkCommand` cannot be spawned. It runs `require('guaraci_cli.check')` directly.

guaraci.srcPath.markdownDescription: Path to a guaraci source checkout (the directory that contains `src/guaraci_cli/check.lua`). Added to `package.path` for the fallback linter. Leave empty when guaraci is installed via LuaRocks.

guaraci.lintOnSave.description: Run guaraci check when a .gc file is saved.

enumDescriptions: HTML mode (default): flags <%= %> inside <script>/<style> blocks as blocked contexts.
Text mode: allows <%= %> inside <script>/<style> (no blocked-context warnings).
guaraci.templateMode.markdownDescription: Template mode passed as `--mode` to `guaraci check`.
